must: Must\ not:\ edit\ the\ source\ SRD\ or\ fix\ anything

rules.rule: An unresolved In Scope TODO marker or non-empty ## TODO section is a blocker
must: an\ unresolved\ draft\ scaffold\ —\ the\ In\ Scope\ `\-\-\-\ TODO\ \-\-\-`\ marker\ or\ a\ non\-empty\ `\#\#\ TODO`\ section

rules.rule: Every mode runs the project-config gate first
must: Every\ mode\ runs\ the\ gate\ in
first

rules.rule: A corpus-unconfirmed claim is a doc gap for report-doc-gap, never a review finding; kb not invoked
must: one\ it\ cannot\ confirm\ is\ a\ doc\ gap\ for\ `srd:report\-doc\-gap`,\ never\ a\ finding\ in\ `<srd>\.review\.md`
`srd:kb`\ is\ not\ invoked

rules.rule: An existing review file is never rewritten; resolve then append with fresh numbers
must: If\ it\ exists,\ do\ not\ rewrite\ it
append\ newly\ found\ defects\ with\ fresh\ numbers

rules.rule: check re-verifies only and hunts no new defects; withdrawal is check-only
must: Re\-verify\ only\ —\ hunt\ no\ new\ defects
Withdrawal\ is\ check\-only

rules.rule: A pass that resolves nothing and appends nothing writes nothing
must: a\ pass\ that\ resolves\ nothing\ and\ appends\ nothing\ writes\ nothing

rules.rule: walk records only findings the user confirms
must: record\ only\ findings\ the\ user\ confirms
Append\ only\ confirmed\ findings\ to\ the\ review\ file
Emit\ plain\ text\ for\ an\ email\ or\ ticket\ —\ no\ file\ write

rules.rule: Reply carries a task line and counts, never the findings
must: the\ reply\ never\ lists\ them
Count\ those\ from\ the\ finished\ file,\ not\ from\ memory

rules.rule: Back-links STR-4/6 never raise a finding
must: never\ raise\ a\ back\-link\ finding

rules.rule: Draft offer is made by report-doc-gap, never inline, and only when this run captured drafts
must: The\ offer\ is\ the\ delegate's,\ never\ written\ inline
a\ run\ that\ captured\ none\ invokes\ nothing\ here\ either

rules.rule: An SRD/KB contradiction is a reference finding naming both claims and both fixes, never settled by rank
must: A\ KB\ section\ contradicting\ the\ SRD\ is\ a\ `reference`\ finding\ too,\ never\ settled\ by\ `rank`\ \(an\ SRD\ has\ none\)

rules.rule: No hard-coded trust order or folder name
